job: Show a value before and after a change, with an arrow between them.
purpose: An inline pair: the old value muted, an arrow read as "to", and the new value in label weight. Figures are tabular; data-mono sets identifiers such as scopes, plans and hosts in the mono face. Without a from part it shows only the new value.
useWhen: A decision or a preview changes a number, a plan or a scope and both values matter.
A list of affected records each shows its old and new value.

avoidWhen.when: The figure is a trend over time with a direction and a percentage.
Two versions of text or code are compared line by line.

variants.useWhen: The values are identifiers: scopes, plan names, hosts, versions.

parts.role: The value after; the arrow is drawn before it.
